name: alexflix
description: AlexFlix — streaming personnel style Netflix pour la Freebox Révolution

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,white "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.deploy: npm run build:vitrine --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix server
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:vitrine --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix server -- --no-links
scripts.deploy:scan: npm run build:vitrine --prefix client && npm run deploy --prefix server -- --scan
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
